title: 3D bar chart
description: A 3D column chart (4-7 bars): bars rise with a stagger, values count up in HTML labels that follow the bar tops, one bar in the accent colour, slow camera drift. Shows its source on screen.

title.description: Headline (one or two lines); wrap one word in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

bars.description: 4-7 items {label, value}. Heights are relative to the largest value. Keep labels short (3-6 characters).

highlight.description: Index (0-based) of the bar drawn in the accent colour; -1 for none.

suffix.description: Text after each value (e.g. %, k, M).

source.default: Source: name of the dataset, year (required)
source.description: Where the numbers come from. Shown on screen; never leave the placeholder.

start.description: Second the first bar starts rising.

rise.description: Seconds each bar takes to rise (values count with it).

theme.description: Backdrop variant from base.css (bars and plinth follow it).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: the source line names a real source
value labels do not overlap at 7 bars
